releaseNotes:
Release v0.23.1

New Features:
- Stop Graph and Stop Run action nodes
- Deploy Graph action
- Workspace lock and run timeout per graph: each graph can wait its turn for a workspace-wide lock and be stopped once it runs too long, with lock/timeout/drop toggles in the graph right-click menu and file tree; the dashboard shows runs waiting for the lock and runs that timed out (PS-273)
- Docker runner: a run that times out now fails the one-shot container (PS-273)
- Explorer: rename and delete solution entries, with reference rewrites and system trash (PS-273)

Bug Fixes:
- Stop actions release stopped triggers and keep execution diagnostics
- Solution JSON serialization is stable
- Explorer: editor saves are serialized with rename/delete; refusal and delete messages are accurate; timeout field takes whole numbers only; entries go to the trash through the file manager (PS-273)
- Delete now warns when closing the deleted file's tab would throw away canvas edits
- Left sidebar no longer scrolls sideways; tabs fit its width

Improvements:
- Desktop, functions and Rust dependencies refreshed and consolidated; GTK and editor-dialog held at compatible versions (PS-277)
